name: company-kernel
description: Prime frontier models with a 2026 system, then ground them in current company and project truth.

interface.shortDescription: A 2026 company operating system for frontier models
interface.longDescription: Install a shared system layer, inherit current company and project truth, load only relevant domain judgment, and let evidence update the narrowest durable level.
defaultPrompt: Use $kernel-setup for installation, migration, route reconciliation, capability audit, or first project initialization.
Use $project-update when durable company, project, domain, evidence, or current-state truth changes.
Use $kernel-review when qualified evidence may require changing system, company, or project context.
